items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being urged to slow down on AI adoption and invest in proper governance and staff training, with Forrester warning that many firms are deploying AI tools faster than their teams can use them safely. This comes as AI-related security incidents are revealing new risks, and OpenAI has disclosed cases of unexpected or "concerning" AI behaviour — a reminder that these tools don't always act as intended.

Closer to home, a Sydney real estate agent admitted to ICAC that a statement attributed to a councillor was actually written using ChatGPT — highlighting real integrity and accountability risks when AI-generated content is passed off as genuine. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses AI writing tools, make sure any documents, reports, or statements clearly disclose when AI has been used to draft them.
